description: This file defines classes and methods for fetching and processing SEC Equity FTD (Failure to Deliver) data, including query parameter handling, data transformation, and asynchronous data extraction from SEC website ZIP files.

classes.name: SecEquityFtdQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for SEC Equity FTD data, including limit, skip_reports, and use_cache.

classes.name: SecEquityFtdData
classes.description: Represents SEC Equity FTD data, extending the standard EquityFtdData with an alias for the settlement date.

classes.name: SecEquityFtdFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching SEC Equity FTD data asynchronously, transforming queries, and processing raw data into standard format.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SecEquityFtdQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts SEC FTD data from the SEC website, handling URL retrieval, data download, and sorting.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionaries into SecEquityFtdData instances.
